simple.meaning: green , i.e. a young ear of grain; hence, the name of the month Abib or Nisan
simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to אָבִיב (H24) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-m.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 8 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: אָבִיב (ʼâbîyb) means green , i.e. a young ear of grain; hence, the name of the month Abib or Nisan First listed occurrence: Deut 16 1.

definitions.short: green , i.e. a young ear of grain; hence, the name of the month Abib or Nisan
definitions.usage: Abib, ear, green ears of corn (not maize).
definitions.full: H24. abib אָבִיב noun masculine Lev 2:14 collective (Lag BN 207 Infinitive) 1 fresh, young ears of barley Exod 9:31 ; indefinite Lev 2:14 א ליהוה בִּכּוּרִים ׳מִנְחַת בָּאֵשׁ קָלוּי . 2 הָֽאָבִיב חֹדֶשׁ month of ear-forming, or of growing green, Abib, month of Exodus & passover, Exod 13:4 ; 23:15 ; 34:18 (twice in verse) (JE), Deut 16:1 (twice in verse) (1st month = circa April = הָר ׳הַחֹדֶשׁ הָרִאשֹׁן, (q. v.) in P; see Di Exod 12:2 ; = post-exilic נִיסָן q. v.) אֲבִגַיִל see אֲבִיגַיִל below II. אבה .
definitions.rootNote: from an unused root (meaning to be tender );
